verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents SSH-based file transfer and volumes for persistent storage, meaning users can copy their data off instances at any time rather than being locked in, but there is no explicit 'export all your data' feature, no open-format data export tool, and no account-closure/data-portability documentation. Missing for 10: dedicated data-export/backup tooling, explicit open-format guarantees, and any documentation addressing full account data portability upon leaving.
